article.story: MEMPHIS, Tenn. -- — Zachary Davis scored 12 points off of the bench to help lead Memphis past North Texas 57-48 on Wednesday. Davis also had six rebounds for the Tigers (6-7). Sincere Parker went 5 of 6 from the field to add 10 points. Dug McDaniel had nine points and shot 4 for 10, including 1 for 5 from beyond the arc. The Mean Green (9-5) were led by Je'Shawn Stevenson, who recorded 20 points, six rebounds and three steals. Memphis entered halftime up 28-16. McDaniel paced the team in scoring in the first half with seven points. Memphis was outscored by North Texas in the second half by one point, with Davis scoring a team-high 10 points after the break. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
